page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom: title block in capitals and italics, author line, edition note in italics, woodcut engraving of a saint with key in the centre, then imprint at the foot. No margins with text.

main_text.l: Nunc primum accessit Disputatio de anno, mense, & die passionis Dominicæ, seorsum edita, eodem autore.
Apud Io. Wecheli relictam viduam, sumtibus

page.notes: Woodcut engraving of a bearded saint holding a key, with a kneeling figure below, within a floral border; not transcribed. Faint stains at upper right corner. The date line is printed as M. D. XCIII. in the scan's old numeral form (XCIII with a reversed-looking final stroke); read as XCIII. The edition note line "Nunc primum accessit" is set in italic with a long-s form rendered as plain s.
